question: Do exact first-party separated-light spectral dye density curves independently distinguish current Fujifilm Velvia 50, Velvia 100 and Provia 100F technical source profiles under the same E-6/CR-56 process label?

comparison.interpolation: linear in wavelength and spectral diffuse density
comparison.pair_metric: root mean square density difference across the concatenated channel-specific common wavelength samples

stop_rules: Do not tune curve points, channel extents, wavelengths, interpolation, uncertainty or gates after any pair score.
Failure closes this exact spectral source signature without channel deletion, smoothing, peak alignment or threshold rescue.

Pass may strengthen the non-renderable technical source profile and open a separately frozen operator-identifiability experiment only; it cannot define a scene-to-display RGB transform, calibrated stock response or product profile.
claim_ceiling: First-party same-manufacturer E-6 separated-light spectral-dye technical-source distinction; not independent film rolls, spectral transmittance, process/scanner calibration, scene-to-display colour response, photographic appearance, stock calibration or product evidence.
